body:
## What changed

The Reports page now opens with a monthly bookkeeping list. One row per job the
bookkeeper does today, and each row says done, missing or not tracked for the chosen
month. The month picker sits next to the heading and the default is this month, so the
page answers "is this month's bookkeeping done" without opening anything. Only months
01 to 12 are accepted; anything else falls back to this month.

Three jobs are judged from data Pecunia already has:

1. Invoices sorted into the archive. Done when every outgoing bank line in the month has a document or a written reason, from the same coverage counts the invoice coverage tool reports. A month before the business's coverage start, or a month with no outgoing payments, shows not tracked.
2. Invoices present for tracked suppliers. Done when every payment from a supplier on Pecunia's invoice list has its invoice. A month with no payment from a tracked supplier shows not tracked rather than done, because there is nothing to prove either way. This row does not measure the one-off SOFT-1915 chasing list.
3. Self Assessment dates tracked. Done when Pecunia stores at least one Self Assessment due for Yeo UX and every payment with a positive amount due on or before the last day of the month is paid. A due date counts whatever return it belongs to, so an unpaid 31 January 2027 balancing payment filed under the return ending 5 April 2026 still makes February 2027 missing. A profile other than Yeo UX shows not tracked, and a profile with no stored due date shows missing.

Six jobs have no data behind them yet, so they always show not tracked with a line saying why: the quarterly HMRC update, the Feral and Wingify invoices, the FreeAgent bank lines, the year-end pack, bookkeeper access, and the VAT limit. The list never marks a job done without data that proves it, because a wrong done would hide missing work.

The rules live in `src/lib/bookkeeping.ts`, the page is `src/routes/reports.tsx`, and `docs/architecture.md` gains a short table of each job and its rule.

## How to see it

Open the preview deployment, go to Reports, and read the bookkeeping section at the top. Change the month with the picker. The link is `/reports?month=YYYY-MM`.

Tests are in `src/__tests__/routes/reports-bookkeeping.test.ts` and cover a done month, a missing month, a not tracked month, an unpaid Self Assessment payment filed under an earlier return, its paid variant, the rendered rows, and a month that does not exist. They need `npm ci` and the Workers test pool, so they run in CI, not on this box: this checkout has no `node_modules` and installing was out of scope.

## How to undo

Revert the squash commit on `main` and let the deploy job publish it. The section disappears and every other report page is untouched. Nothing was migrated, no schema changed, and no data was written.
title: SOFT-1910: Pecunia Reports shows each month's bookkeeping
